title: Two-input gate well-formedness
statement: Let $k$ be an AND, OR, or NOT gate kind with $k\ne\mathrm{NOT}$, and let $a,b$ be distinct natural numbers. The gate of kind $k$ with inputs $a$ and $b$ is well formed and has at most two inputs.
